sources.title: Despite ongoing legal issue, Alaric Jackson will practice with Rams
sources.description: Even though Rams tackle Alaric Jackson won't be charged with a felony following an offseason domestic battery accusation, he could be entering a diversion program in lieu of a misdemeanor prosecution.
